reason: 该插件的核心是为 DSH Web 提供一个右侧工作区面板，用户界面层提供文件树与编辑、Git 审查和终端相关功能，属于面向本地工作流的文件与终端增强插件；同时其能力还包括自定义面板布局、宽度拖拽与多文件标签管理，这与 readme 与包说明中的功能表述一致。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，在右侧工作区面板中提供文件浏览与编辑、Git 审核和终端入口，并支持拖拽调整面板宽度及多文件标签切换。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a right-side DSH Web workspace panel for file browsing/editing, Git review, and terminal access, with resizable layout and multi-file tab support.

capabilities: Browse workspace files and open multiple files in panel tabs
Inspect Git review/diff related workspace content
Launch and interact with terminal sessions via plugin APIs
Render and resize a custom right-side panel UI in the DSH workspace

reasons.code: README documents a right-side workspace panel with file tree/preview/edit, Git review, and terminal features plus /side-panel/api for file/Git/terminal interactions.
Package description and metadata identify the plugin as a DSH Web plugin for file workspace, Git review, and terminal usage.
README states local API host/origin loopback checks for /side-panel/api and terminal process error handling, indicating active runtime-side operations.
